# InBharat AI

> InBharat is an independent AI product studio building affordable, voice-first,
> multilingual AI tools for Bharat. Products span agentic search, coding
> assistants, education, healthcare and business automation, working across 11
> Indian languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Gujarati,
> Kannada, Malayalam, Odia and Assamese.

Founded by Reeturaj Goswami. Operated by Uni Guru Technologies LLP, a
DPIIT-recognised startup (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning sector,
Government of India).

## Recognitions and programmes

- DPIIT-Recognised Startup, AI & ML — Department for Promotion of Industry and
  Internal Trade, Government of India. Held by Uni Guru Technologies LLP.
- Stanford Seed Spark 2026 — Stanford Seed, Stanford Graduate School of Business.
- OpenAI Partner Network — member, partner onboarding completed 2026.
- Google Cloud Gen AI Academy, APAC Cohort 3 (2026) — Google Cloud.
- Hyperagent Founding 500, founding member.
- Sarvam Startup Program — Sarvam AI.
- Google Developer Program: Premium tier; Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready badge;
  5-Day AI Agents intensive.
- Anthropic Education: Introduction to Model Context Protocol; AI Fluency for
  Educators (both July 2026).
- Microsoft Education: AI tools for educators modules.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.inbharat.ai/): the product ecosystem and what InBharat builds.
- [About](https://www.inbharat.ai/about): who InBharat is and how it works.
- [Learn AI with Reeturaj](https://www.inbharat.ai/learn-ai-with-reeturaj): founder-led practical AI articles for Bharat.
- [Contact](https://www.inbharat.ai/contact): how to reach the team.

## Products

- [KathaKitaab](https://www.kathakitaab.com): AI storytelling and interactive learning.
- [JAK Swarm](https://jakswarm.com): agentic automation and multi-agent orchestration.
- [UniAssist.ai](https://www.uniassist.ai): AI guidance for students and study-abroad.
- [TestsPrep](https://testsprep.in): AI-powered test preparation.
- [Sahayaak Seva](https://sahayaakseva.in): AI healthcare and field-assistance workflows.
- [OpenClawFix](https://openclawfix.pro): developer tooling.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- All public pages are crawlable; see https://www.inbharat.ai/robots.txt.
- Canonical host is https://www.inbharat.ai (the apex redirects here).
- Full article text is present in the served HTML, so pages can be read without
  executing JavaScript.
- Sitemap: https://www.inbharat.ai/sitemap.xml
